about.title: Two Worlds, One Vision
about.quote: Being alive is an ethical commitment to safeguarding life on Earth — in whatever way we can, and wherever we stand.
about.bio: I am Morteza Pourmirzai, a wildlife conservation practitioner and founder of Sarvin Wildlife Conservation. My primary dedication is preserving threatened feline species—particularly the Asiatic cheetah—alongside the strategic management and ecological restoration of natural habitats across Iran. Before founding Sarvin, I served as CEO of the Iranian Cheetah Society, spearheading multi-sector initiatives spanning field research, educational advocacy, and ranger support.
about.bio2: Beyond the steppe and mountain corridors, I have built AI agents and automation workflows, designed websites and web-based reporting dashboards, developed bots, led a digital-marketing team, and worked across SEO. I believe transformative conservation emerges when rigorous science, ethical human collaboration, and modern tools unite.

timeline.text: Began volunteering with the Iranian Cheetah Society, starting hands-on ecological fieldwork.
Directed national educational and public awareness campaigns with the Iranian Cheetah Society.
Appointed CEO of the Iranian Cheetah Society; spearheaded large-scale habitat restoration and camera-trap monitoring.
Founded Sarvin Wildlife Conservation Institute to pioneer sustainable wildlife stewardship and technology integration.
